subtasks.details: Update frontend/src/types/stores.ts to add AuthState interface with userId: string | null, email: string | null, name: string | null, shadowUserId: string, accessToken: string | null, refreshToken: string | null, tokenExpiresAt: number | null fields. Add AuthActions interface with login(credentials) returning Promise, logout() method, refreshToken() returning Promise, setShadowUser(id: string) method. Add UiState interface with modalStates: Map<string, ModalState>, toastQueue: Toast[], panelStates object, activeTool: string, keyboardShortcuts: Map<string, KeyboardShortcut>. Add UiActions with all modal, toast, panel, and tool methods. Define supporting types like ModalState, Toast (with id, message, type, duration), and ensure compatibility with existing store types
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify TypeScript compilation with new types, test type inference in store hooks, validate interface compatibility with existing components

subtasks.title: Integrate stores with React Context and create custom hooks
subtasks.description: Create React Context providers and custom hooks for authStore and uiStore following the existing store integration pattern
subtasks.details: Create frontend/src/stores/index.ts exports for new stores. Implement AuthStoreProvider and UiStoreProvider React Context components following the pattern from existing stores. Create useAuthStore and useUiStore hooks that use useContext to access store state and actions. Add the new providers to the main App component provider tree alongside existing providers. Ensure proper TypeScript typing for context values and hook returns. Export createAuthStore and createUiStore functions for testing purposes. Update STORE_NAMES in indexedDBStorage.ts to include AUTH: 'auth-store' and UI: 'ui-store' entries
subtasks.testStrategy: Test context provider rendering, verify hook access to store state and actions, test store isolation between different provider instances, validate TypeScript type inference

subtasks.title: Wire uiStore to existing UI components and implement API integration
subtasks.description: Connect uiStore to ExportModal, panels, and future toast components, and integrate authStore with API calls and cookie handling
subtasks.details: Update ExportModal component to use useUiStore for open/close state instead of local state. Create a new ToastContainer component that reads from uiStore.toastQueue and renders toast notifications with auto-dismiss. Update panel components to use uiStore.panelStates for visibility. Integrate useKeyboardShortcuts hook with uiStore.keyboardShortcuts Map. For authStore, create an api/auth.ts service file with login/logout/refresh endpoints. Implement shadow user cookie handling in authStore initialization - check for existing cookie or generate new shadowUserId. Add auth headers to existing API calls using accessToken from authStore. Implement token refresh logic with automatic retry on 401 responses. Ensure all state changes use proper Zustand actions
subtasks.testStrategy: Test modal state synchronization, verify toast rendering and dismissal, test panel visibility toggles, validate API authentication flow with mock responses, test shadow user cookie persistence
